entries.source: Download the scene as GLB, including any finished rig
entries.translation: 把場景下載成 GLB，包括已完成的骨架

entries.source: Collapse or expand the model shop
Demo credits. Lessons are not connected yet.
entries.translation: 示範金幣；目前尚未連接課堂進度。
示範控制（並非課堂獎勵）

entries.source: 🖱️ Drag: look around · Scroll: zoom · Click: pick a shape · Shift-click: pick several · 🏠 resets the view
entries.translation: 🖱️ 拖曳：轉動視角 · 捲動：縮放 · 點按：選取形狀 · Shift+點按：選取多個 · 🏠 重設視角

entries.source: Collapse or expand the AI panel
entries.translation: 收起或展開 AI 面板

entries.source: Choose the AI model to use
entries.translation: 選擇要使用的 AI 模型

entries.source: Load the model list from the server
entries.translation: 從伺服器載入模型清單

entries.source: Send only the selected shapes, or the whole scene as context
entries.translation: 只傳送選取的形狀，或把整個場景作為背景資料

entries.source: The key is stored only in this browser.
entries.translation: 金鑰只會儲存在這個瀏覽器。

entries.source: Ask the AI to rebuild your shapes...
entries.translation: 請 AI 改造你的形狀……

entries.source: — add shapes to make a body
— tap the model to grow a skeleton of joints
entries.translation: — 點按模型，逐步加上關節骨架

entries.source: — turn a ring and watch it bend!
entries.translation: — 轉動圓環，看看模型如何彎曲！

entries.source: Undo the last stroke (Clay Studio has its own undo)
entries.translation: 復原上一筆（黏土工作室有獨立的復原記錄）

entries.source: Reset this shape to a fresh ball
entries.translation: 把形狀重設為一個新球

entries.source: Discard the sculpt and go back
Keep the sculpt and go back to the 3D Studio
entries.translation: 保留塑形結果並返回 3D 工作室

entries.source: How to use the Clay Studio

entries.translation: 梯度下降是怎樣運作的
用梯度下降做線性迴歸
用手肘法選擇 K 值
K-Means 的限制與其他方法

entries.source: A friendly cube to start your champion.
entries.translation: 一個友善的小方塊，陪你開始製作 AI Champion。

entries.source: A round head that bounces with every step.
entries.translation: 圓圓的頭，每走一步都會彈一彈。

entries.source: A pointy nose cone for speedy champions.
entries.translation: 尖尖的火箭頭，讓 AI Champion 看起來跑得更快。

entries.source: A spinning ring with real party energy.
entries.translation: 會旋轉的圓環，充滿派對氣氛。

entries.source: A shiny column. Reach level 3 and pay up.
entries.translation: 閃亮的圓柱。達到等級 3，再用金幣解鎖。

entries.source: The veteran capsule. Level 5 and 200 coins.
entries.translation: 進階銀色膠囊。達到等級 5，並花 200 金幣解鎖。

entries.source: Keep the object's current X, Y and Z proportions while scaling
entries.translation: 縮放時保持物件目前的 X、Y 和 Z 比例

entries.source: Turn your build into a 3D cartoon model with AI
entries.translation: 讓 AI 把你的作品變成 3D 卡通模型

entries.source: Describe a character and let AI make it in 3D
entries.translation: 描述一個角色，讓 AI 製作成 3D 模型

entries.source: Give the model a skeleton in Rig mode first — tap the model to place joints.
entries.translation: 首先在裝備模式下為模型提供骨架 - 點擊模型以放置關節。

entries.source: Tap a ball. The ring appears at the joint above it — that is the hinge. Turn the ring to swing the lit piece. The first ball turns the whole model. Rest straightens everything.
entries.translation: 點擊一個球。環出現在其上方的關節處－即鉸鏈。轉動環來擺動點亮的部件。第一個球轉動了整個模型。休息可以解決一切問題。

entries.source: Working out the bending… you can pose as soon as it is ready.
entries.translation: 正在計算彎曲效果……完成後就能擺姿勢。

entries.source: How thick the torus ring is
Open this shape in the Clay Studio — pull, push, smooth, grab, carve and paint it, then press Done to put it back sculpted.
entries.translation: 在黏土工作室為這個形狀塑形：拉出、推入、抹平、抓取、刻畫或塗色。完成後按「完成」，把它放回場景。

entries.source: This piece is not bound to any bone yet.
entries.translation: 這件裝備尚未連接到骨骼。

entries.source: Attach this gear piece to a bone so it moves with the champion. Pick a bone here, then tune with the gizmo.
entries.translation: 把這件裝備連接到骨骼，它便會跟着 AI Champion 移動。先在這裏選擇骨骼，再用控制器調整。

entries.source: Detach this piece from its bone so it stays where it is but no longer follows the skeleton.
entries.translation: 將這塊碎片從骨頭上拆下來，讓它留在原來的地方，但不再跟隨骨架。

entries.source: 👆 Click a shape or a joint ball to see its details here.
entries.translation: 👆 點擊形狀或關節球可在此處查看其詳細資訊。

entries.source: This piece is not bound to any bone yet — it is floating freely.
entries.translation: 這件裝備尚未連接到骨骼，可以自由移動。

entries.source: Tap the model to place the first joint.
entries.translation: 點按模型，放下第一個關節。

entries.source: Tap the model again to add a second joint — one joint cannot bend.
entries.translation: 再點按模型，加入第二個關節；只有一個關節無法彎曲。

entries.source: There is no model to rig yet. Generate or import one, then tap it.
entries.translation: 目前沒有模型可以加關節。請先建立或匯入模型，再點按它。

entries.source: That tap missed the model. Tap the model to place a joint.
entries.translation: 剛才沒有點到模型。請點按模型來放下關節。

entries.source: That joint sits on the skin, not inside the model — drag it in.
entries.translation: 這個關節在模型表面，請把它拖進模型內。

entries.source: Tap the model to start a new chain.
entries.translation: 點擊模型即可開始新的鏈。

entries.source: Tap a joint ball first, then Remove joint.
entries.translation: 先敲擊關節球，然後拆下關節。

entries.source: Skeleton and bending loaded from the file.
entries.translation: 已從檔案載入骨架和彎曲效果。

entries.source: No joint is inside a shape yet — drag the joints into the model.
entries.translation: 形狀內還沒有關節 - 將關節拖曳到模型中。

entries.source: The bending could not be worked out. Try moving the joints inside the model, or Undo the last change.
entries.translation: 無法解決彎曲問題。嘗試移動模型內的關節，或復原最後的變更。

entries.source: Give the selected model a skeleton using UniRig
entries.translation: 用 UniRig 為選取的模型建立骨架

entries.source: Deselect, so the next tap on the model starts a new chain of joints
entries.translation: 取消選擇，以便下次點擊模型時會啟動新的關節鏈

entries.source: Remove the selected joint and everything hanging off it (Delete)
entries.translation: 移除選取的關節，以及連在下方的所有關節（Delete）

entries.source: Skeleton cleared. Undo brings it back.
entries.translation: 已清除骨架。按「復原」可還原。

entries.source: tap again to grow the chain
tap a ball, then the model, to branch
entries.translation: 先點按關節球，再點按模型，讓關節鏈分支

entries.source: Select the model or all its parts in Build mode first.
entries.translation: 請先在「製作」模式選取模型或它的所有部件。

entries.source: Build or import a model first.
Select all parts of the existing rig before replacing its skeleton. Unrigged models can stay unselected.
entries.translation: 在更換骨架之前選擇現有裝備的所有零件。未組裝的模型可以保持未選取狀態。

entries.source: Select all parts that share this skeleton before auto-rigging.
entries.translation: 在自動組裝之前選擇共享此骨架的所有零件。

entries.source: The model has no usable volume.
The model or skeleton changed while auto-rigging. Try again with the current model.
entries.translation: 自動加關節期間，模型或骨架改變了。請用目前的模型再試一次。

entries.source: The returned rig has no binary mesh data.
entries.translation: 傳回的裝備沒有二進位網格資料。

entries.source: The returned rig has no mesh data.
entries.translation: 傳回的裝備沒有網格資料。

entries.source: The service changed the model frame. Your original model is unchanged.
entries.translation: 該服務改變了模型框架。你的原始模型沒有改變。

entries.source: The service returned no usable skeleton (2–256 joints required).
entries.translation: 該服務沒有返回可用的骨架（需要 2-256 個關節）。

entries.source: The returned skeleton has no usable connected bones.
entries.translation: 返回的骨骼沒有可用的連接骨骼。

entries.source: The service returned a joint far outside the model.
entries.translation: 該服務返回了一個遠離模型的關節。

entries.source: Enter a complete API endpoint URL.
entries.translation: 輸入完整的 API 端點 URL。

entries.source: Use HTTPS for the API endpoint (HTTP is allowed on localhost).
entries.translation: 對 API 端點使用 HTTPS（本機上允許使用 HTTP）。

entries.source: Use an endpoint without credentials, query parameters or a fragment. Put the key in API key.
entries.translation: 使用沒有憑證、查詢參數或片段的端點。將金鑰放入 API 金鑰中。
選擇受支援的自動加關節提供者。

entries.source: Auto-rig took too long. Your model is unchanged. Try again later.
entries.translation: 自動加關節花了太長時間。你的模型沒有改變。稍後再試。
該服務未返回任何設備。

entries.source: The rigged GLB is too large (maximum 30 MB).
entries.translation: 組裝的 GLB 太大（最大 30 MB）。

entries.source: Your selected model will be uploaded to this API endpoint.
entries.translation: 你選擇的模型將上傳到此 API 端點。

entries.source: Using your local Hugging Face login. Usually takes about 1–2 minutes.
entries.translation: 使用你本地的 Hugging Face 登入。通常需要大約 1-2 分鐘。

entries.source: Enter your Hugging Face token to connect. Usually takes about 1–2 minutes.
entries.translation: 輸入你的 Hugging Face 權杖進行連接。通常需要大約 1-2 分鐘。

entries.source: Enter a Hugging Face access token first.
entries.translation: 請先輸入 Hugging Face 存取權杖。

entries.source: The selected model changed. Close this panel and choose it again.
entries.translation: 所選模型已更改。關閉該面板並再次選擇它。

entries.source: Building the skeleton… This usually takes about 1–2 minutes.
entries.translation: 建立骨架…這通常需要大約 1-2 分鐘。

entries.source: Auto-rig timed out. Your model is unchanged. Try again later.
entries.translation: 自動加關節逾時。模型保持不變，請稍後再試。

entries.source: Finish rigging the model before animating it.
entries.translation: 在為模型設定動畫之前完成模型的組裝。

entries.source: Step needs leg segments. Use Waddle for a body without legs.
entries.translation: 腳步需要腿段。對於沒有腿的身體使用 Waddle。

entries.source: A selected leg is no longer in this rig.
entries.translation: 選定的腿不再在此裝備中。

entries.source: Choose one upper segment per leg, not both an upper and lower segment of the same leg.
entries.translation: 每條腿選擇一個上段，而不是同一條腿的上段和下段。

entries.source: Settings changed. Press Play to preview.
entries.translation: 設定已更改。按下“播放”即可預覽。

entries.source: Give the model a skeleton and wait for bending to finish first.
entries.translation: 給模型一個骨架，先等待彎曲完成。

entries.source: An end joint cannot be a knee: it needs a foot joint below it.
entries.translation: 最末端的關節不能作為膝蓋；膝蓋下方還需要腳部關節。

entries.source: Automatic uses Waddle: shift weight and rock the body without legs. Review the suggested head and arm roles.
entries.translation: 自動使用搖晃：轉移重心並在沒有腿的情況下搖晃身體。查看建議的頭部和手臂角色。

entries.source: Fit needs a skeleton — in Rig mode, tap the model to place joints, then come back.
entries.translation: 穿裝備前，模型需要骨架。請先在「加關節」模式點按模型，放下關節。

entries.source: Remove the currently selected gear piece from the model
entries.translation: 從模型移除目前選取的裝備

entries.source: Load a gear piece to start fitting.
entries.translation: 載入一件裝備，開始穿裝備。

entries.source: No .glb / .gltf / .fbx / .obj model among the chosen files.
entries.translation: 選取的檔案沒有 .glb、.gltf、.fbx 或 .obj 模型。

entries.source: Fit needs a skeleton (Rig mode) before you can load gear.
entries.translation: 載入裝備前，請先在「加關節」模式建立骨架。

entries.source: Could not load that gear file.
No bone available to seat that piece on.
entries.translation: 沒有骨頭可以放置該部件。

entries.source: Select a gear piece to bind first.
entries.translation: 請先選取要連接骨骼的裝備。

entries.source: Select a gear piece to unbind first.
entries.translation: 請先選取要解除連接的裝備。

entries.source: Load a gear piece first — the fit tools move that.
entries.translation: 請先載入一件裝備；穿裝備工具會移動它。

entries.source: Select a gear piece to remove it.
entries.translation: 請先選取要移除的裝備。

entries.source: Select a gear piece to download.
entries.translation: 請先選取要下載的裝備。

entries.source: Could not bake the fitted piece.
entries.translation: 無法烘烤已安裝的零件。

entries.source: Fit at least one gear piece first.
entries.translation: 請先替模型穿上一件裝備。

entries.source: Wait for bending to finish before downloading your champion.
entries.translation: 等待彎曲完成後再下載你的冠軍。

entries.source: Colour that stays glued to the clay
Reset this shape? Your sculpting and paint will be lost.
entries.translation: 要重設這個形狀嗎？塑形和塗色結果會消失。

entries.source: The AI reply was too large to read safely. Ask for a smaller result.
entries.translation: AI 的回覆太長，無法安全讀取。請它縮短回覆。

entries.source: The AI service took too long to answer. Try again.
entries.translation: AI 服務回應時間過長。再試一次。

entries.source: Could not reach the AI service. Check the connection and try again.
entries.translation: 無法連接 AI 服務。請檢查網絡，再試一次。

entries.source: Your API key was rejected. Check it in AI settings.
entries.translation: 你的 API 金鑰被拒絕。在AI設定中檢查一下。

entries.source: This key is not allowed to use that model.
entries.translation: 此密鑰不允許使用該模型。

entries.source: Model not found. Pick another from the list.
entries.translation: 未找到模型。從清單中選擇另一個。

entries.source: Too many requests — wait a moment and try again.
entries.translation: 請求太頻密。請稍等片刻，再試一次。

entries.source: The AI service had a problem. Try again.
entries.translation: AI 服務出現問題。再試一次。

entries.source: Could not reach the AI service. Check the connection and try again.
entries.translation: 無法連接 AI 服務。請檢查網絡，再試一次。

entries.source: The AI service sent an unexpected reply. Try again.
entries.translation: AI服務發出了意想不到的回應。再試一次。

entries.source: The AI service sent an unexpected reply. Try again.
entries.translation: AI服務發出了意想不到的回應。再試一次。

entries.source: The AI service sent an unexpected reply. Try again.
entries.translation: AI服務發出了意想不到的回應。再試一次。

entries.source: The AI service sent an empty reply. Try again.
entries.translation: AI 服務發送了一個空回覆。再試一次。

entries.source: The key is stored only in this browser.
entries.translation: 金鑰只會儲存在這個瀏覽器。

entries.source: Could not reach the AI service. Check the connection and try again.
entries.translation: 無法連接 AI 服務。請檢查網絡，再試一次。

entries.source: Load the model list from the server
entries.translation: 從伺服器載入模型清單

entries.source: The reply looks incomplete — it was cut off before the end. Ask for a shorter result and try again.
entries.translation: 回覆未完成，內容提早中斷。請 AI 縮短回覆後再試。

entries.source: The reply did not include any shapes, so there is nothing to preview. Ask again and describe the shapes you want.
entries.translation: 回覆沒有任何形狀，因此無法預覽。請再說明你想要的形狀。

entries.source: Select a shape first, or switch Context to the whole scene.
entries.translation: 請先選取一個形狀，或把「範圍」改為整個場景。

entries.source: Add your server URL, API key and model in AI settings first.
entries.translation: 請先到 AI 設定加入伺服器網址、API 金鑰和模型。

entries.source: Still finishing the last request — wait a moment, then send again.
entries.translation: 上一個請求尚未完成。請稍等片刻，再傳送。
已取消 — 沒有發送任何內容。

entries.source: Clear the chat and the preview
Add your API key in AI settings first.
entries.translation: 首先在 AI 設定中新增你的 API 金鑰。

entries.source: The AI request failed. Try again.

entries.translation: 在此處貼上 hf_… 標記

entries.source: Enter a browser API key or a fal-compatible server/proxy URL.
entries.translation: 輸入瀏覽器 API 金鑰或相容 fal 的伺服器/代理 URL。

entries.source: Paste a fal API key here
entries.translation: 在此處貼上 fal API 金鑰
可選的 fal 相容代理 URL

entries.source: Use the official TokenHub API key. The optional URL must speak Tencent TokenHub's API protocol.
entries.translation: 使用官方 TokenHub API 金鑰。可選的 URL 必須使用騰訊 TokenHub 的 API 協定。

entries.source: Paste a Tencent TokenHub API key here
entries.translation: 在此粘贴腾讯TokenHub API密钥
一起編輯四視圖工作表。

entries.source: Direct fal API. Edits the four-view sheet together.
entries.translation: 直接使用 fal API，一次修改四個視圖。

entries.source: Direct fal API. Fast single-picture generation.
entries.translation: 直接fal API。快速產生單張圖片。

entries.source: Tencent Hunyuan Community (excludes EU, UK and South Korea)
entries.translation: 騰訊混元社群（不包括歐盟、英國和韓國）

entries.source: Shape works. Texture is disabled on this Space even though its API lists the endpoint.
entries.translation: 形狀作品。即使其 API 列出了端點，該空間上的紋理仍處於停用狀態。

entries.source: Returns the original textured model by default. Optional mesh simplification exports an untextured shape; if export fails, the original is kept with a notice.
entries.translation: 預設回傳原始紋理模型。可選的網格簡化匯出無紋理的形狀；如果匯出失敗，保留原件並附上通知。

entries.source: Commercial use via fal; provider and model terms apply
entries.translation: 可透過 fal 作商業用途；須遵守服務商和模型的條款。

entries.source: Paid fal API. Accepts front, back, left and right views and returns a textured GLB.
entries.translation: 付費 fal API。接收前、後、左、右四個視圖，傳回有紋理的 GLB。

entries.source: Paid fal API. Single-picture generation with independent resolution, texture size and vertex target controls.
entries.translation: 付費fal API。具有獨立解析度、紋理大小和頂點目標控制的單一圖片生成。

entries.source: Tencent Hunyuan model and TokenHub service terms apply
entries.translation: 騰訊混元模式及TokenHub服務條款適用

entries.source: Official TokenHub API. This connection sends one picture as base64 and returns a textured GLB. TokenHub multiview needs hosted image URLs, so it is not wired to the four-view step yet.
entries.translation: 官方 TokenHub API。此連線以 base64 形式傳送一張圖片並傳回帶有紋理的 GLB。 TokenHub 多視圖需要託管圖像 URL，因此它尚未連接到四視圖步驟。

entries.source: Not connected: its single-image, multi-call session flow still needs an adapter.
entries.translation: 未連線：其單一影像、多重呼叫會話流程仍需要適配器。

entries.source: Not connected: its hosted texture flow is single-image only and still needs an adapter.
entries.translation: 未連接：其託管紋理流僅是單一圖像，並且仍然需要適配器。

entries.source: The seam is ready, but no standalone mesh-texturing service is connected.
entries.translation: 接縫已準備就緒，但未連接獨立的網格紋理服務。

entries.source: An adult needs to set up the AI connection in Settings first.
entries.translation: 請成人先到「設定」建立 AI 連線。

entries.source: The AI key was not accepted. An adult can check it in Settings.
entries.translation: AI 金鑰無效。請成人到「設定」檢查。

entries.source: Today's AI time is used up. Try again later, or show the sample.
entries.translation: 今天的 AI 使用時間已用完。請稍後再試，或查看範例。

entries.source: The AI service is busy. Try again, or show the sample.
entries.translation: AI 服務正忙。請重試，或查看範例。

entries.source: The AI service can't be reached right now. Try again, or show the sample.
entries.translation: 暫時無法連接 AI 服務。請重試，或查看範例。

entries.source: Something went wrong making this. Try again, or show the sample.
entries.translation: 創作時出了問題。請重試，或查看範例。

entries.source: createGenService: providers and config() are required
There is nothing to photograph yet — add a shape first.
entries.translation: 還沒有什麼可以拍攝的——先加入一個形狀。
對 3D 網格進行紋理化

entries.source: The prompt that will be sent
Type what it is, and the prompt appears here.
entries.translation: 輸入想創作的東西，文字指令就會顯示在這裏。

entries.source: a dinosaur with spikes on its back
a blue dragon with big wings
entries.translation: 一條長著大翅膀的藍龍

entries.source: The prompt that will be sent
Use my view as the front
Send my whole build, not just what I picked
entries.translation: 發送我的整個構建，而不僅僅是我選擇的

entries.source: These four pictures will be sent. Turn them so the AI sees the front of your model, then press Send.
entries.translation: 這四張照片將會被發送。轉動它們，讓 AI 看到模型的正面，然後按「發送」。

entries.source: This is a ready-made example, not made from your build.
entries.translation: 這是一個現成的範例，不是根據你的構建製作的。
你的 3D 模型，正在轉動

entries.source: The picture it was made from
entries.translation: 它的圖片是由它製作的

entries.source: The preview could not be shown, but the model is ready.
entries.translation: 無法顯示預覽，但模型已準備就緒。

entries.source: Choose a model for each step. Capabilities and licence limits are shown because models are not interchangeable.
entries.translation: 為每個步驟選擇 AI 模型。各模型的功能和授權限制不同，這裏會顯示供你比較。

entries.source: Options for the selected models, using each provider’s supported ranges, choices and defaults. Hunyuan shape-detail presets change voxel resolution, not face count. Mesh simplification is optional.
entries.translation: 這裏顯示所選模型支援的數值範圍、選項和預設值。Hunyuan 的形狀細節預設值會改變體素解像度，而非面數。你也可以選擇簡化網格。

entries.source: Add each provider once; every selected model from that provider reuses this connection. Settings are stored in localStorage on this device and sent only to that provider. A server URL must speak that provider's protocol.
entries.translation: 每個服務商只需設定一次；該服務商的模型會共用這個連線。設定儲存在這部裝置的 localStorage，只會傳送給相應服務商。伺服器網址必須支援該服務商的通訊方式。

entries.source: Use restricted test keys in this browser-only demo. Put keys behind a server proxy before production.
entries.translation: 在此僅限瀏覽器的示範中使用受限測試鍵。在生產之前將密鑰放在伺服器代理後面。

entries.source: Model loading timed out. Try again.
entries.translation: 載入模型逾時，請再試一次。

entries.source: Saved shop progress needs a different app version. It has been kept unchanged.
entries.translation: 保存的商店進度需要不同的應用程式版本。它一直保持不變。

entries.source: Saved shop progress could not be read. It has been kept unchanged.
entries.translation: 無法讀取已儲存的商店進度。它一直保持不變。

entries.source: Shop progress could not be updated.
Shop progress could not be saved. No credits were spent.
entries.translation: 無法保存商店進度。沒有花費任何積分。

entries.source: This browser cannot safely update shop progress. Use a browser with Web Locks support.
entries.translation: 此瀏覽器無法安全地更新商店進度。使用支援 Web Locks 的瀏覽器。

entries.source: Model loading timed out. Try again.
entries.translation: 載入模型逾時，請再試一次。

entries.source: The model could not be opened.
Reset demo credits and skill progress? Your scene will be kept.
entries.translation: 要重設示範金幣和技能進度嗎？你的場景會保留。

entries.source: Sculpted — it is back in your scene! ✨
entries.translation: 塑形完成！它已回到場景中。✨

entries.source: No sculpting done, so the shape is unchanged.
entries.translation: 沒有進行塑形，形狀保持不變。

entries.source: Sculpt cancelled — the shape is unchanged.
entries.translation: 已取消塑形，形狀保持不變。

entries.source: Imported with its skeleton and bending.
entries.translation: 其骨架和折彎均採用進口。

entries.source: Skeleton kept — working out the bending
Imported. Tap it in Rig mode to give it a skeleton.
entries.translation: 進口的。在裝備模式下點擊它，給它一個骨架。

entries.source: Added your AI model beside your build. Undo removes it.
entries.translation: 在你的构建旁边添加了你的 AI 模型。復原會將其刪除。

entries.source: Nothing to rest — give the model a skeleton in Rig mode first.
entries.translation: 沒什麼好休息的——首先在 Rig 模式下給模型一個骨架。

entries.source: Add or generate a model first, then export.
entries.translation: 先新增或產生模型，然後匯出。

entries.source: Wait for the bending to finish before exporting this skeleton.
entries.translation: 等待彎曲完成後再匯出此骨架。

entries.source: Exported my-model.glb with its skeleton, Walk and Jump.
entries.translation: 已匯出 my-model.glb，包含骨架、行走和跳躍動畫。

entries.source: Build something first, then make it real.
entries.translation: 首先建造一些東西，然後將其變為現實。

entries.source: Bones are part of the skeleton — use Clear skeleton in Rig mode to remove them.
entries.translation: 骨骼是骨架的一部分 - 在裝備模式下使用「清除骨架」來移除它們。

entries.source: Nothing selected to delete. Click a shape first.
entries.translation: 沒有選擇要刪除的內容。首先點選一個形狀。

entries.source: Select a shape (or several, with Shift-click) to duplicate.
entries.translation: 選擇一個形狀（或多個，按住 Shift 鍵並點擊）進行複製。

entries.source: Start a new scene? Your current work will be lost.
entries.translation: 要開始新場景嗎？目前的作品將會消失。

entries.source: A temporary light copy goes to your chosen rigging service. Your original detail stays here. You can adjust the joints afterwards, or Undo.
entries.translation: 系統會把簡化後的暫時副本傳送到你選擇的加關節服務。原本的細節會保留在這裏。完成後，你可以調整關節或按「復原」。

entries.source: Use my local Hugging Face login
entries.translation: 使用本機的 Hugging Face 登入

entries.source: Hugging Face access token (this tab only)
entries.translation: Hugging Face 存取權杖（只在此分頁使用）
API 金鑰（選填，只在此分頁使用）

entries.source: Use an endpoint that accepts a GLB upload and returns a rigged GLB. API keys are sent as Bearer tokens. The server must allow browser access (CORS).
entries.translation: 使用能接收 GLB 並傳回已加骨架 GLB 的端點。API 金鑰會以 Bearer 權杖傳送。伺服器必須允許瀏覽器存取（CORS）。

entries.source: Connection settings stay in this tab until you reload. They are not saved with your model.
entries.translation: 連線設定只會留在此分頁，重新載入後就會消失，也不會與模型一起儲存。

entries.source: Automatic motion preview. Check the suggested legs and adjust the direction. Walk stays in place.
entries.translation: 預覽自動動作。檢查建議的腿部關節，再調整方向。行走動畫會留在原位。
搖擺 — 左右轉移重心
身體部位 — 修改自動建議

entries.source: Check each knee joint; its parent is the hip. Confirm its foot and bend direction below. Knees stay 8–120° from straight; unreachable targets may slip instead of overextending. Play saves these animations for Export.
entries.translation: 檢查每個膝蓋關節：它的上層關節是髖部。確認下方的腳部和彎曲方向。膝蓋會保持彎曲 8–120°；如果目標太遠，腳可能會滑動。按「播放」會儲存動畫，供匯出使用。

entries.source: Could not start the 3D view (WebGL is not available). Try a different browser, or restart this one.
entries.translation: 無法開啟 3D 畫面（WebGL 無法使用）。請換一個瀏覽器，或重新啟動目前的瀏覽器。

entries.source: A skeleton is a chain of joints. Tap the model in Rig mode to place the first joint; every next tap adds a joint linked to the selected one. Tap a ball to select it, so the next tap branches from there. Drag a ball to move it — turn the model and drag again to set its depth. The bending is worked out for you a moment after you stop. Joints belong to the shape you tapped: move, turn or scale the shape and they come along. A shape with no joint inside rides the nearest bone.
entries.translation: 一副骨架由一串關節組成。在加關節模式點按模型，放下第一個關節；之後每點按一次，就會加上一個連接到所選關節的新關節。點按關節球來選取它，下一次點按便會從那裏分支。拖曳關節球可移動它；轉動模型後再拖曳，就能調整深度。放開後，系統會稍後算出彎曲效果。關節會跟着你點按的形狀移動、旋轉和縮放。若形狀內沒有關節，它會跟着最近的骨骼移動。

entries.source: In Pose mode, tap a ball. The ring appears at the joint above it — that is the hinge. Turn the ring to swing the lit piece. The first ball turns the whole model. Rest straightens everything; Export saves a .glb with the skeleton, and importing that file brings the skeleton back.
entries.translation: 在擺姿勢模式點按關節球。上方關節會出現圓環，那就是轉動的位置。轉動圓環，讓亮起的部分擺動。第一個關節球會轉動整個模型。按還原姿勢可拉直模型；按匯出可把骨架一起存成 .glb。再匯入該檔案，骨架也會回來。

entries.source: The FRONT arrow points toward +Z — build your character facing that way. Red = X (right), green = Y (up), blue = Z (forward).
entries.translation: FRONT 箭嘴指向 +Z。製作角色時，讓它面向這個方向。紅色 = X（右）、綠色 = Y（上）、藍色 = Z（前）。

entries.source: Build (1) — add shapes and move them around.
entries.translation: 製作（1）— 加入形狀並移動它們。

entries.source: Rig (2) — tap the model to place joints; drag balls to move them.
entries.translation: 加關節（2）— 點按模型放下關節；拖曳關節球來移動。

entries.source: Pose (3) — tap a ball and turn the ring at the joint above it to swing the lit piece.
entries.translation: 擺姿勢（3）— 點按關節球，再轉動上方關節的圓環，讓亮起的部分擺動。

entries.source: Fit (4) — load a gear model (GLB / OBJ / FBX), pick a slot, auto-fit it onto the current character, then adjust it with Move / Rotate / Scale and download the result.
entries.translation: 穿裝備（4）— 載入裝備模型（GLB / OBJ / FBX）、選擇位置，自動穿到目前角色身上，再用「移動／旋轉／縮放」調整和下載。

entries.source: Delete / Backspace — delete the selected shape · Ctrl+D — duplicate · Ctrl+Z — undo · Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y — redo
entries.translation: Delete / Backspace — 刪除選取的形狀 · Ctrl+D — 複製 · Ctrl+Z — 復原 · Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y — 重做

entries.source: G / R / S — move / rotate / scale gizmo · 1-4 — switch modes
entries.translation: G / R / S — 移動／旋轉／縮放控制器 · 1-4 — 切換模式

entries.source: In Scale, turn on Keep proportions to resize an object without changing its shape.
entries.translation: 使用「縮放」時，開啟保持比例，就能在不改變形狀的情況下調整大小。

entries.source: Move several shapes at once: Shift-click to select a few shapes, then drag the gizmo — they all move, spin, or scale together around one shared centre. Ctrl+D duplicates the whole selection.
entries.translation: 一次移動多個形狀：按住 Shift 並點按幾個形狀，再拖曳控制器。它們會圍繞同一個中心一起移動、旋轉或縮放。按 Ctrl+D 可複製整組。

entries.source: Shape sculpting: select a shape, then press 🧱 Sculpt in its Details to open the Clay Studio with just that shape. Pull, Push, Smooth, Grab, Carve and Paint it, with Mirror and Undo. Press ✅ Done to put the sculpted shape back in your scene.
entries.translation: 形狀塑形：選取一個形狀，在「詳細資料」按🧱 塑形，便可在黏土工作室塑造這個形狀。你可以拉出、推入、抹平、抓取、刻畫和塗色，也可以使用鏡像和復原。按✅ 完成，就能把塑形後的形狀放回場景。

entries.source: This is the shape you picked — sculpt it with your finger, like playdough!
entries.translation: 這是你選取的形狀。像玩黏土一樣，用手指替它塑形吧！

entries.source: One finger on the clay sculpts it with the chosen tool. One finger on the background turns the shape around. Two fingers (or pinch) zoom.
entries.translation: 在黏土上用一根手指，可用選取的工具塑形。在背景用一根手指，可轉動形狀。用兩根手指捏合，可縮放。

entries.source: Pull / Push — pinch the surface in or out. Smooth — soften bumps. Grab — drag a lump around. Carve — scratch a thin line. Paint — add colour that stays glued to the shape.
entries.translation: 拉出／推入 — 把表面拉出或壓入。抹平 — 弄平凸起。抓取 — 拖動一塊黏土。刻畫 — 刻出細線。塗色 — 塗上會跟着形狀移動的顏色。

entries.source: Mirror sculpts both sides at once. Brush sets the tool size. Undo steps back one stroke. ✅ Done puts the sculpted shape back in your scene; ✕ Cancel throws the sculpt away.
entries.translation: 鏡像會同時塑造兩側。筆刷可調整工具大小。復原可退回上一步。按✅ 完成可把形狀放回場景；按✕ 取消會放棄這次塑形。

entries.source: ${t2.text} Go back to Rig mode to fix it.
entries.translation: ${t2.text} 請返回加關節模式修正。

entries.source: Bound to ${n2.boneKey}. Pick a bone to move it, or Unbind to make it float.
entries.translation: 已連接到 ${n2.boneKey}。選取骨骼來移動它，或按「解除連接」讓它自由移動。
正在計算彎曲效果……${V_[t2] || t2} ${Math.round(e27 * 100)}%

entries.source: ${e28} joints sit outside the model — drag them inside.
entries.translation: 有 ${e28} 個關節在模型外面，請把它們拖進模型內。

entries.source: The rigging API returned HTTP ${n4.status}. Check the endpoint and API key.
entries.translation: 加關節 API 傳回 HTTP ${n4.status}。請檢查端點和 API 金鑰。

entries.source: ${u2} joints added. Working out the bending. Undo brings the previous skeleton back.
entries.translation: 已加入 ${u2} 個關節，正在計算彎曲效果。按「復原」可還原之前的骨架。

entries.source: Leg ${t3} needs a knee and a foot below it. Choose a higher knee segment or correct its foot.
entries.translation: 腿部 ${t3} 需要膝蓋和下方的腳。請選擇較高的膝蓋部位，或修正腳的位置。

entries.source: Leg ${t3} has a zero-length thigh or lower leg. Correct its joints before animating.
entries.translation: 腿部 ${t3} 的大腿或小腿長度為零。請先修正關節，再製作動畫。
已把 ${i2.name} 重新穿到 ${e28.name}（保留原有姿勢）。

entries.source: Could not download the dressed model: ${e27.message}
entries.translation: 無法下載已穿裝備的模型：${e27.message}

entries.source: 🧱 Sculpting "${n3.name}" — one finger sculpts, one finger on the background turns, pinch zooms.
entries.translation: 🧱 正在塑造「${n3.name}」— 在形狀上用一根手指塑形；在背景上用一根手指轉動；捏合可縮放。

entries.source: The AI's reply needed one small fix (${n2}), so it was adjusted and previewed anyway.
entries.translation: AI 的回覆有一個小問題（${n2}），已修正並顯示預覽。
這次請求很大（約 ${PC(n2).toLocaleString()} 個 token）。

entries.source: The AI returned ${n2} shapes — only the first ${r2} will be applied.
entries.translation: AI 傳回 ${n2} 個形狀；只會使用前 ${r2} 個。
已使用 ${n2} 個形狀中的前 ${r2} 個。
正在排隊：前面還有 ${e27} 個

entries.source: Sending your whole build — all ${n2} shapes, not just the ${t2} you picked.
entries.translation: 將傳送整個作品的 ${n2} 個形狀，包括未選取的形狀；你選取了 ${t2} 個。
第 ${n2} 部分，共 ${r2} 部分
達到等級 ${r2.level}，並花 ${r2.coins} 金幣

entries.context: Skill tree reward; Chinese has no plural suffix
Skill tree reward; Chinese has no plural suffix
AI Optimization result; Chinese has no plural suffix

entries.translation: 有 ${s2.length} 個形狀無法建立。
entries.context: AI Optimization error; Chinese has no plural suffix

entries.translation: 已把 ${t2} 個形狀取代為 ${n2.length} 個。
entries.context: AI Optimization result; Chinese has no plural suffix

entries.translation: 有 ${r2.length} 個形狀無法建立。
entries.context: AI Optimization error; Chinese has no plural suffix
Main studio result; Chinese has no plural suffix
Main studio result; Chinese has no plural suffix

entries.source: 1 joint sits outside the model — drag it inside.
entries.translation: 有 1 個關節在模型外面，請把它拖進模型內。

entries.source: The service returned an invalid GLB.
entries.translation: 服務傳回的 GLB 無效。

entries.source: The returned rig must be a self-contained GLB.
entries.translation: 傳回的骨架必須是一個完整的 GLB 檔案。

entries.source: The returned skeleton has an invalid hierarchy.
entries.translation: 傳回的骨架關節層級無效。

entries.source: The service returned an invalid model URL.
entries.translation: 服務傳回的模型網址無效。
行走方式或柔和程度無效。

entries.source: A body role is invalid for this rig.
entries.translation: 這副骨架有一個無效的身體部位設定。

entries.source: Not connected: multiview requires session state that is not yet verified end to end.
entries.translation: 尚未連接：多視圖功能需要跨步驟保存資料，目前尚未完成驗證。

entries.source: Shop models must be static meshes. Import rigged models through Import GLB.
entries.translation: 商店模型必須是不帶骨架的靜態模型。如要匯入有骨架的模型，請使用「匯入 GLB」。

notes: Review catalog for later integration. Locations in the JavaScript bundle refer to a prettified copy of the exact downloaded file. Expression placeholders, file formats, keyboard shortcuts, identifiers and URLs are retained.
